name: codex-mirror
description: Mirrors a project's Claude Code agents and skills onto Codex: every agent of .claude/agents/ and of each enabled plugin becomes a .codex/agents/*.toml, .claude/skills/ is copied to .agents/skills/, and a model table maps each Claude model to a Codex model. A SessionStart hook reports generated files that are missing or out of date. Codex cannot load a subagent from a plugin; this is how a plugin's agents reach it.
